Title: Experienced Roofer
Description: We are looking for an experienced roofer to join our team at Storm Pro Roofing. The ideal candidate has hands-on roofing experience,takes pride in quality workmanship, and is committed to maintaining a safe and professional work environment.
Requirements: Knowledge of roofing materials, tools, and installation techniques
Ability to work safely at heights and outdoors in various weather conditions
Strong work ethic, attention to detail, and reliability
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Duties: Install, repair, and replace roofing systems according to project specifications
Remove existing roofing materials and prepare roof surfaces
Measure, cut, and install roofing materials
Inspect completed work to ensure quality and durability
Maintain a clean and organized job site
Follow workplace safety procedures and use protective equipment
Work with team members to complete projects efficiently

Title: Roofing laborer
Description: Storm Pro Roofing is looking for a dependable roofing laborer to support our roofing team on residential and other roofing projects. This is a great opportunity for someone willing to learn, work hard, and develop practical skills in the roofing industry. Previous experience is helpful but not required.
Requirements: Previous construction or roofing experience is an asset but not required
Comfortable working at heights and outdoors in various weather conditions
Strong work ethic and ability to follow directions
Physically able to perform manual labor and lift roofing materials
Reliable, punctual, and willing to learn
Duties: Assisting with tear-offs and material handling
Handling tools and materials as directed
Keeping work areas clean and organized
